one_sentence_story: Sarah-Jayne Blakemore, Daniel Wolpert, and Chris Frith (Nature Neuroscience 1998; J. Cogn. Neurosci. 1999) placed 16 volunteers in fMRI with a master-slave robotic tickling lever, proving that cerebellar forward models cancel self-generated touch at 0 ms delay — but inserting a 100–200 ms robotic delay restores full ticklishness!
so_what_for_you: Understanding how your cerebellum and somatosensory cortex interact lets you work with your brain's hardware instead of fighting it.
